searchText: This question doesn't really make sense. If you want to spin up a private network, download one or more of the clients and configure it to run a private network. man this is tilting.,.. why do people keep saying i dont understand i want to create a private network, similar to the actual Ethereum network (the public one) why? because i want to test around and see how fast the TPS are in a private network Any of the execution clients will support this. Take your pick which one to use, and follow the instructions for that tool on configuring and starting a private network but i also want to use zkSync or polygon as layer 2 an example of such client? https://geth.ethereum.org/docs/interface/private-network WAIT this means i can pick the layer 2 myself? whichever implementation? pls say yes No, that is about the method used by the layer 1 to come to consensus. A layer 2 network will be separate, sending its proofs to layer 1 for security. To find out about layer 2 testnets you should visit their own Discords. You can find details about various layer 2 solutions at https://l2beat.com/ but its possible to add layer 2 such as lets say polygon or zkSync into my private network? That would be a question for the layer 2 team.
